edges.reason: fundEther authorizes on _msgSender derived from msg.sender.
defundEther authorizes on _msgSender derived from msg.sender and transfers to it.
initialize grants admin and operational roles to _msgSender.
_authorizeUpgrade restricts upgrades based on _msgSender role check.
FUNDER_ROLE gates the fundEther entry point.
FUNDER_ROLE gates the defundEther entry point.
WITHDRAWAL_ROLE is assigned during initialization.
defundEther performs the ETH transfer to the caller.
withdrawEther performs the ETH transfer to the proof-derived receiver.
withdrawEther relies on verifyProof signature recovery before transferring.
verifyProof executes the ecrecover over caller-supplied proof and signature.
External ETH transfer occurs before processedWithdrawals is set, allowing reentrant withdrawal of the same proof.
depositEtherFor adds the computed fee into _collectedFees.
depositEtherFor mutates the _collectedFees state variable.
userAddress parameter is consumed by depositEtherFor.
amount parameter is consumed by depositEtherFor.
_calculateFee reads _feeRate when computing the fee.
_calculateFee produces the fee local variable used in depositEtherFor.
withdrawEther uses the proof-decoded amount parameter.
withdrawEther derives receiverAddress from the proof RLP list.
withdrawEther marks processedWithdrawals for the decoded txnHash.
withdrawEther parses the caller-supplied proof calldata.
Decoded withdrawal amount flows into the ETH transfer.
Decoded receiver address flows into the ETH transfer target.
Computed fee is added into _collectedFees.
defundEther amount parameter flows into the ETH transfer.
_setSigner writes the _proofSigner state variable.
_setFeeRate writes the _feeRate state variable.
setSigner invokes the internal _setSigner after admin check.
setFeeRate invokes the internal _setFeeRate after admin check.
initialize signer_ parameter flows into _setSigner.
initialize feeRate_ parameter flows into _setFeeRate.
initialize grants FUNDER_ROLE.
initialize grants WITHDRAWAL_ROLE.
ContextMixin.msgSender returns msg.sender when the caller is not the contract itself.
feeAmount delegates fee computation to _calculateFee.
_authorizeUpgrade and getImplementation are both part of the upgradeable proxy surface.

normalization_plan.reason: userAddress parameter is only meaningful inside depositEtherFor.
amount parameter is only meaningful inside depositEtherFor.
proof calldata parameter is only consumed by withdrawEther.
withdrawal amount parameter is decoded solely to size the ETH transfer.
fee local variable is collapsed into the _collectedFees arithmetic operation.
receiverAddress local is collapsed into the ETH transfer target.
defundEther amount parameter is collapsed into the ETH transfer operation.
initialize signer_ parameter is collapsed into _setSigner.
initialize feeRate_ parameter is collapsed into _setFeeRate.
